request.name: get_virtual_desktop

description.summary: get the org_kde_plasma_virtual_desktop for a given desktop id

request.description: Given the id of a particular virtual desktop, get the corresponding org_kde_plasma_virtual_desktop which represents only the desktop with that id.

arg.name: desktop_id
arg.summary: the id of the desktop to get

request.name: request_create_virtual_desktop

description.summary: ask to create a new virtual desktop

request.description: Ask the server to create a new virtual desktop, and position it at a specified position. If the position is zero or less, it will be positioned at the beginning, if the position is the count or more, it will be positioned at the end.

arg.name: name
arg.summary: the name of the desktop to create

arg.name: position
arg.summary: the position of the desktop to create

request.name: request_remove_virtual_desktop

description.summary: ask to remove a virtual desktop

request.description: Ask the server to get rid of a virtual desktop, the server may or may not acconsent to the request.

arg.name: desktop_id
arg.summary: the id of the desktop to remove

event.name: desktop_created

description.summary: a new desktop has been created

event.description: A new virtual desktop has been created, along with its position.

arg.name: desktop_id
arg.summary: the id of the new desktop

arg.name: position
arg.summary: the position of the new desktop

event.name: desktop_removed
event.description: A virtual desktop has been removed: the compositor will send a "removed" event on the corresponding org_kde_plasma_virtual_desktop object as well.

arg.name: desktop_id
arg.summary: the id of the removed desktop

event.name: done
event.description: This event is sent after all other properties has been sent after binding to the desktop manager object and after any other property changes done after that. This allows changes to the org_kde_plasma_virtual_desktop_management properties to be seen as atomic, even if they happen via multiple events.

event.name: rows

description.summary: the number of rows in the desktop grid

event.description: The number of rows the virtual desktops are laid out in.

request.name: request_activate

description.summary: ask the compositor to make this desktop the current one

request.description: Request the server to set the status of this desktop to active: The server is free to consent or deny the request.

event.name: desktop_id
event.description: The format of the id is decided by the compositor implementation. A desktop id uniquely identifies a virtual desktop and must be guaranteed to never exist two desktops with the same id. The format of the string id is up to the server implementation.

event.name: name
event.description: The human readable name of this virtual desktop.

event.name: activated

description.summary: this desktop has become the current one

event.description: The desktop will be the new "current" desktop of the system. The server may support either one virtual desktop active at a time, or other combinations such as one virtual desktop active per screen at any time. The "activated" event is not necessarily followed by a "deactivated" event on another desktop.

event.name: deactivated

description.summary: this desktop is no longer the current one

event.description: The desktop is not the current one any more.

event.name: done
event.description: This event is sent after all other properties has been sent after binding to the desktop object and after any other property changes done after that. This allows changes to the org_kde_plasma_virtual_desktop properties to be seen as atomic, even if they happen via multiple events.

event.name: removed
event.description: This virtual desktop has been removed and the client should destroy the org_kde_plasma_virtual_desktop object.
